verify.evidence: PASS/production-catalog: public.spatial_ref_sys carries the enabled triggers sec007_rows (BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, per row) and sec007_truncate (BEFORE TRUNCATE) running sec007_block_browser_writes(), so browser writes are blocked while SELECT and extension ownership are unchanged. The table grants themselves stay because supabase_admin issued them and postgres cannot revoke them. Reopen if either trigger is dropped or disabled.
